title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-gitignore-wrangler: carry parked/agent/gitignore-wrangler onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/gitignore-wrangler` at 65aaeceecb holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: .gitignore, site/worker.js)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/gitignore-wrangler
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/agent/gitignore-wrangler

**Evidence:** Superseded: main's .gitignore already lists .wrangler/ and no .wrangler cache file is tracked; the branch's site/worker.js copy adds an unverifiable claim about QNFO that CLAIMS-1 would flag.
